name: apc_classic_ti_only
description: APC injection against TestTarget (MITRE T1055.004). RQ3 evasion: only ETW-TI subscribed.

extra.expected_fingerprint: 1x OpenProcess (attacker → target with hostile mask), 1x OpenThread (attacker → target thread), 1x ALLOCVM_REMOTE (RWX trampoline, ~4KB), 1x WRITEVM_REMOTE (shellcode + zeroed counter, single 4KB write), 1x KERNEL_THREATINT_TASK_QUEUEUSERAPC (or similarly-named APC dispatch event — verify empirically). Notably absent: 0x THREAD_CREATE_REMOTE (unlike LL/MM), 0x SETTHREADCONTEXT (unlike TH). This is the sharpest single case for the thesis's central claim that kernel-level events catch what thread-creation-anchored detectors miss.
